definition_title: The torsion field of a mod-$\ell$ representation
definition:

import Mathlib.FieldTheory.Galois.Infinite
import Definitions.Def_AbcAdaptation_Reference_Iut_Concrete_CurveData

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AbcAdaptation.Reference.Iut.EllipticCurveData.ModEllRepData

open NumberField

universe u

variable {C : EllipticCurveData.{u}} {ℓ : ℕ} (R : C.ModEllRepData ℓ)

/-- The torsion field cut out by the kernel of the mod-`ℓ` representation. -/
noncomputable def torsionField : IntermediateField C.F C.Fbar :=
  IntermediateField.fixedField R.rep.ker

/-- The fixed field is finite over the base number field because the kernel is open. -/
instance numberField_torsionField : NumberField ↥R.torsionField := by
  have hle : R.rep.ker ≤ R.torsionField.fixingSubgroup :=
    (IntermediateField.le_iff_le R.rep.ker R.torsionField).mp le_rfl
  have hopen : IsOpen (R.torsionField.fixingSubgroup : Set (C.Fbar ≃ₐ[C.F] C.Fbar)) :=
    Subgroup.isOpen_mono hle R.ker_isOpen
  haveI : FiniteDimensional C.F ↥R.torsionField :=
    (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite R.torsionField).mp hopen
  exact NumberField.of_module_finite C.F ↥R.torsionField

end AbcAdaptation.Reference.Iut.EllipticCurveData.ModEllRepData
natural_language_statement:
**English**

Let $\rho_\ell$ be the mod-$\ell$ Galois representation of an elliptic curve over a number field $F$. Its torsion field is the fixed field of $\ker\rho_\ell$ in the chosen algebraic closure of $F$. The open kernel gives a finite extension of $F$, so the fixed field is a number field.

**简体中文**

设 $\rho_\ell$ 是数域 $F$ 上椭圆曲线的模 $\ell$ 伽罗瓦表示。其挠点域是 $\ker\rho_\ell$ 在选定的 $F$ 的代数闭包中的不动域。核是开子群，因而该不动域是 $F$ 的有限扩张，也是数域。

**日本語**

数体 $F$ 上の楕円曲線の法 $\ell$ ガロア表現を $\rho_\ell$ とする。捩れ点体は、選んだ $F$ の代数閉包における $\ker\rho_\ell$ の固定体である。核は開部分群なので、この固定体は $F$ の有限拡大であり、数体である。
source: Shinichi Mochizuki, Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory I, Definition 3.1(c). Formal source of the kernel fixed field and number field proof at the fixed iut revision. https://github.com/lana-agents/iut/blob/07cb1da58f6d428a670dbb5dd6093d428bcbcdd8/Iut/Cor312/ThetaData/AdmissiblePrime.lean#L171 https://github.com/lana-agents/iut/blob/07cb1da58f6d428a670dbb5dd6093d428bcbcdd8/Iut/Cor312/ThetaData/LocalConditions.lean#L96
